meta.question: please give me information present in Backend Engineering Standards and Code Review Policy

response.answer: The Backend Engineering Standards and Code Review Policy (ZEN-DPL-BKE-01) aims to keep backend services reliable, secure, and easy to change. It applies to all engineers who change backend code or services and mandates trunk-based development with branches lasting no longer than 2 days, pull requests under 400 lines, and CI passing for all changes. Review requirements include 1 approval for most services, while billing, payments, and authentication paths require 2 approvals including a Principal Engineer or Director; additionally, new code must have 80% unit test coverage, public APIs require 6 months' notice for deprecation, database migrations must be backward compatible, and secrets must be stored in AWS Secrets Manager.
